title: Non-Dyadic Odd-Prime QFT 2-Bin Capture Bound and Exact Modular Rounding Recovery
claims: Applying an m-qubit dyadic QFT_{2^m}^dagger to a prime-modulus Z_q phase progression concentrates > 8/pi^2 ~ 81.057% of the probability mass into the 2 nearest bins {floor(2^m z / q), ceil(2^m z / q)}.
Whenever 2^m >= 2*q, the closed-form rounding map z_hat(k) = floor((q * k + 2^{m-1}) / 2^m) mod q deterministically recovers z = a*s mod q on both nearest bins across 100% of z in Z_q.
favorable_controls: Resolved prime instances q=17, 2^m=64 and q=31, 2^m=64
